name: botz-mcp-swarm
description: Capture, run, and diagnose MCP test suites with the botz MCP Swarm CLI.

interface.shortDescription: Capture, run, and diagnose MCP test suites
interface.longDescription: Skills for the botz MCP Swarm CLI: capture suites from live MCP servers, run repeatable assertions and load tests, diagnose failures, and upgrade saved suites. The skills install the botz host and its mcp-swarm extension on first use.
